transcript: Speaker A: बेटी की शादी है, 2 लाख रुपये चाहिए। सैलरी 8000 रुपये, 55 साल का हूँ। एक दिन सोसाइटी के एक लड़के ने बोला, अंकल इंग्लिश सीख लो। कॉर्पोरेट में सिक्योरिटी सुपरवाइजर की जॉब मिल जाएगी, सैलरी तीन गुना। [My daughter is getting married, I need 2 lakh rupees. Salary is 8000 rupees, I am 55 years old. One day a boy from the society said, Uncle learn English. You will get a security supervisor job in a corporate office, with three times the salary.] ... Speaker B: अंकल आप रोज़ 8 घंटे यहाँ बैठे रहते हो खाली। ये 8 घंटे में इंग्लिश सीख सकते हो, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Uncle, you sit here idle for 8 hours daily. You can learn English in these 8 hours, download the English Seekho app.] ... Speaker A: इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। इंग्लिश नहीं आती तो 8000 की नौकरी मिलती है, इंग्लिश आ गई तो 22000 की। [Download the English Seekho app. If you don't know English, you get an 8000 job; if you know English, you get a 22000 job.]
on_screen_text:
English Seekho
INSTALL NOW
English Seekho kisi bhi government authority institution brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai... [English Seekho is not endorsed, sponsored, affiliated, or associated with any government authority, institution, brand, organization, or individual...]
summary: A 55-year-old security guard earning 8,000 rupees needs money for his daughter's wedding but faces rejection at corporate job interviews due to poor English. A resident advises him to utilize his idle 8-hour night shifts to learn English using the 'English Seekho' app. He successfully improves his skills, gets a job paying 22,000 rupees, and proudly funds his daughter's wedding.
